entries.summary: Know basic interpersonal etiquette and forms of interaction in major countries, including cultural continuity and mutual respect.
Know representative Chinese and international people of strong character and their deeds.
Know notable Chinese and international artists, representative works and their implied meanings.
Know notable Chinese and international scientists, major contributions, and their humanistic and scientific qualities.
Know names, customs, characteristic activities and historical origins of major Chinese and international festivals.
Know Chinese and international dining etiquette, characteristic food and cultural meanings.
Know names and basic facts about major countries, including capitals, location, languages and climate, plus social development and notable landmarks’ locations, features and symbolic meanings.
Know life stories and quotations of notable Chinese and international figures and the values or life lessons they convey.
Understand culturally situated attitudes and ideas about life safety and health.
Understand differing cultural approaches to financial management and their effects.
Know major Chinese and international sporting competitions, event information, historical development, outstanding people and sporting values.
Understand working practices and attitudes toward labour across cultural settings.
Know how young people in different countries study and live.
